title: Carry the rider-visible Pulse fare through request confirmation into Hoy Driver Inbox
acceptanceCriteria: The exact fare shown to the rider is carried into the authoritative Ride Requests row.
The quote is cryptographically bound to quote ID, route, pickup time, fare, pricing version, and expiry before submission.
Expired, modified, route-changed, or pickup-time-changed quote payloads fail closed.
Hoy Driver reads the stored quoted fare and displays it in the existing Inbox card.
The request app remains the only Ride Requests writer.
Existing QR same-day behavior, future scheduling, PULSE-079 held requests, lifecycle, and fare calculation are not rebuilt.
No production deployment or automatic merge occurs.
